name: ADA4075-2
type: Bipolar low-noise, low-power dual (iPOLAR), SMD only
tagline: 2.8 nV/√Hz at just 1.8 mA per amp; ADI's pick for DAC I/V, used by Matrix Audio for DAC filtering.

lineage.note: Sole source. Rev. 0 datasheet dated 10/08, matching the 2008 SPICE copyright; in EAGLE's library since 2009-12-22.

part_numbers.note: Dual only; no single or quad. Specified −40 to +125 °C; distributors stock it.
Narrow SOIC-8, RoHS; -RL is a 13-inch reel. Newark lists 6.5 MHz NSOIC.
SOIC-8 on 7-inch reel; probably active, no distributor page confirmed.
8-LFCSP-UD (2 × 2 mm), 7-inch reel, per DigiKey. LFCSP added in Rev. A.

key_specs.value: 9 V min total (SPICE: 9/30 V); max unconfirmed, ~±18 V
key_specs.condition: THD+N plotted at ±5 V and ±18 V

reputation.summary: An engineer's part rather than an op-amp-rolling favourite. ADI markets it for power-limited hi-fi and instrumentation, and AN-1429 recommends it for DAC I/V stages. Matrix Audio's Mini-i Pro 2S uses it for the DAC low-pass filter and to drive a TPA6120A2. Soomal ranks it with the LME49720 as a 'very high-end low-distortion op amp'.
typical_uses: Headphone pre-driver, e.g. ahead of a TPA6120A2
NE5532 replacement where current is limited (unconfirmed)
caveats: Needs at least 9 V total supply: unsuitable for 5 V or ±2.5 V rails (AN-1429).
Not rail-to-rail: about 2 V headroom per rail, so 3.0 V peak (2.13 V rms) at ±5 V.
Bipolar input, so current noise matters; one Japanese ADC designer chose the FET OPA1656 for kilohm networks.
SMD only (SOIC-8 or 2 × 2 mm LFCSP): socket rolling needs a DIP adapter.
Confirm the maximum supply before ±18 V NE5532 sockets. No ASR, Head-Fi or diyAudio reports found.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit or remarking reports. As an SMD-only part rarely rolled, fakes seem less likely than for NE5532, OPA2134 or LME49720 (unconfirmed). Buy from authorized ADI distributors; be wary of marketplace DIP-adapter modules.

silicon_changes.summary: ADI added its Wilmington, MA fab (ADWL) as an alternate to Limerick (ADLK) for 'High Voltage Bipolar Products'. Sources conflict on whether ADA4075-2ARZ is listed, and whether its iPOLAR process falls in that scope is not stated. Inclusion is unconfirmed.
silicon_changes.identification: No marking change known; trace by date code or lot after implementation. PCN Rev. - form dated 4 Apr 2023, reportedly effective 7 Jul 2023; Revs. A and C followed.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected: ADI states no fit, form, function or reliability impact; same process at an alternate fab.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: alternate-fab qualification with no datasheet change; not a new die.
silicon_changes.verification: Sources conflict on ADA4075-2ARZ inclusion. PCN 23_0069 was checked: it covers 0.6 µm CMOS/BiCMOS isolators, not this part.
